narrative.overview: A publication that runs on a database, not a SaaS app with a blog. References: Rest of World, The Ken, Stratechery restraint applied to Indian small business. Warm-neutral and quiet with one confident indigo accent; numbers in tabular figures are the texture. Dense where data lives, generous where prose lives. The codebase's real failure mode is not the PRODUCT.md anti-references but accidental color noise (14 decorative hues) and a flat, ungrouped nav that hides two-thirds of the site.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper neutrals, never cold dashboard grey, never pure black or white.
One indigo accent; all other color is semantic (positive / caution / alert), never decorative.
Numbers are first-class typography with tabular figures.
Editorial density: tight in data, generous in prose.
Thumb-first navigation and tap targets before any desktop polish.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Indigo is the only non-semantic color on any screen, covering ≤10% of the surface. Delete any second decorative hue.

rules.name: The Earned Color Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, red appear only attached to a number, status, or provenance label whose meaning they carry. Color is data, not decoration.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: Every comparable figure uses tabular figures and right-aligns in tables.

rules.name: The Quiet Kicker Rule
rules.body: The uppercase tracked label is a kicker, not section grammar. At most one per major section.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Content cards have a border, not a shadow, until hover.

dos: Do keep indigo (#4f46e5) as the only decorative color, on ≤10% of any screen.
Do attach green / amber / red to a number, status, or provenance label that gives them meaning.
Do set every comparable figure in tabular figures and right-align it in tables.
Do show provenance ('as of FY24, source: MCA AOC-4') as a styled micro-line.
Do group navigation into ≤5 top-level destinations with labelled dropdowns; every tool reachable in one tap.
Do use warm paper (#fbfaf8) and warm ink (#16181d); tint neutrals toward the brand hue.
Do give content cards a hairline border and keep them flat until hover.
donts: Don't introduce a second decorative hue; the 14-color spread is the anti-pattern to remove.
Don't use #000 or #fff as text or page background.
Don't ship VC-Twitter SaaS hero gradients or Stripe-purple washes.
Don't drift toward JustDial / IndiaMart density: yellow CTAs, cramped grids, four ads per fold.
Don't copy Medium-style listicle layouts with stock photos and no real numbers.
Don't use fintech glassmorphism or the 'Total Revenue ↑12%' hero-metric template.
Don't use crypto-neon: black backgrounds with electric numbers, ticker tape.
Don't float content cards with drop-shadows at rest, or nest a card inside a card.
Don't rely on color alone for status; pair every semantic color with an icon or label.
Don't leave navigation as a flat, ungrouped row that hides two-thirds of the site behind /tools.
